helpBanner.title: Learn how rules work
helpBanner.actionLabel: See how automation organizes your transactions

helpDrawer.title: Learn how rules work
helpDrawer.intro: Rules help organize your finances automatically. They match transaction descriptions and assign new values to make tracking easier.

items.item1: When a transaction’s description matches the text defined in the rule, the app automatically applies a new description, a category, tags, and a merchant.
items.item2: The app checks for a custom rule first (created by you), then an automatic one (created by the app). If multiple rules match, the one with the highest priority is applied.
items.item3: For manual transactions, category and tags are only assigned if you left them blank when creating the entry.
